title: ModuleCatalogService
responsibility: Discover available definitions and project installation state from a working directory or immutable source tree.

inputs.name: ModuleCatalogService.load.root
inputs.description: Absolute project directory containing the package manifest and module metadata.

inputs.name: ModuleCatalogService.at.tree
inputs.description: Source reader for exactly the selected project revision.

inputs.name: ModuleCatalogService.state.tree
inputs.description: Source reader for exactly the selected project revision.

inputs.name: ModuleCatalogService.state.gaps
inputs.description: Optional collection of readable catalog errors; omitted for strict mutation admission.

outputs.name: ModuleCatalogService.load
outputs.description: Validated definitions, installed flags, generated instances and explicit discovery gaps.

outputs.name: ModuleCatalogService.at
outputs.description: Validated definitions, installed flags, generated instances and explicit discovery gaps.

outputs.name: ModuleCatalogService.state
outputs.description: Persisted module snapshots and generated resource records; absent state is empty.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Invalid definitions, incompatible project settings, unsafe paths or conflicting source files prevent the operation.
